title: New Appointment Of Miss S. R. J. Feigelman

page_data.en:
Foreign Affairs
September 5, 1944.
$ 11
new appointment of Miss S/A/.J Feigelman 577
18 9 33
Information has been received, that Sophia/Raisa/ Janke-
levna FEIGELMAN USSR citizen of Jewish origin, born in 1908
Kharkov employed as a typist at USSR Consulate General and
subsequently at Tass News Agency No 51 Canton Road is attached
to S.P.SUZDALEFF USSR Consular representative at Shanghai as
secretary and stenographer.
Miss S/V.J.FEIGELMAN has reputation of trusted capable
Soviet employee. Her brother Leonid Jarkelevich FEIGELMAN
employee of "International Forwarding Co" No 70 Szechuen Road
is suspected of being connected with Soviet Intelligence
service.
Miss S.J.FEIGELMAN resides at No 455/17 Rue Lafayette
together with her parents, father Jankel J.FEIGELMAN born in
1870 at Desna Vilno, Lithuania, mother Lea Borisovna FEIGELMAN
born in 1872 at Desna, Vilno Province, Lithuania and her illegitimate daughter Maria Constantinovna FEIGELMAN born on
August 1, 1940 at Shanghai.
In the same address at present is residing brother
of Miss S.J.FEIGELMAN mentioned above L.J.FEIGELMAN and
his wife Mrs Berta Aronovna FEIGELMAN born on 22.6.1913 at
Harbin Russian Jewess by origin. She married L.J.FEIGELMAN
on 21.1.38 at Shanghai. and is in possession of a USSR passport No 075782.
g Tcheremchansky (印)
D.S.I.
Officer i/c Foreign Affairs.
（批：Sophia agent）
（左侧竖排手写文字：人 抑 9 2 ト 作 表 せ 之）
page_data.zh:
外事科
1944年9月5日。
$ 11
S.A.J. Feigelman 小姐的新任命 577
18 9 33
据获情报，Sophia/Raisa/ Jankelevna FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼），苏联公民，犹太裔，1908年生于哈尔科夫，曾在苏联驻上海总领事馆担任打字员，随后在广东路51号塔斯社新闻机构工作，现作为秘书及速记员附属于苏联驻上海领事代表 S.P. SUZDALEFF（苏兹达列夫）。
S.V.J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）小姐享有值得信赖且能干的苏联雇员之声誉。其兄 Leonid Jarkelevich FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼），系四川路70号“国际转运公司”职员，被怀疑与苏联情报机关有关联。
S.J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）小姐与其父母同住于拉斐特路455/17号。父亲 Jankel J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼），1870年生于立陶宛维尔诺的德西纳；母亲 Lea Borisovna FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼），1872年生于立陶宛维尔诺省的德西纳；以及其非婚生女儿 Maria Constantinovna FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼），1940年8月1日生于上海。
目前，上述 S.J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）小姐之兄 L.J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）及其妻子 Berta Aronovna FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）夫人也居住于同一地址。Berta Aronovna FEIGELMAN 夫人，1913年6月22日生于哈尔滨，俄籍犹太人。她于1938年1月21日在上海与 L.J. FEIGELMAN（费格尔曼）结婚，并持有苏联护照，号码为075782。
Tcheremchansky（切列姆昌斯基）（印）
特别调查股股长
外事科主管官员。
（批注：Sophia 为特工）
（左侧竖排手写文字：人 抑 9 2 ト 作 表 せ 之）
